decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt">Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, only removable film to the window glazing is accepted, rather than blinds within the historic core (ie the listed building with the exception of the Victorian rear addition), unless it can demonstrated that blinds can be installed in a fully reversible manner and without harming significance otherwise through their design via:</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">a) details and trial area for the proposed blinds in the historic core of the building being submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">Reason to preserve the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">All works of repair, reinstatement&nbsp;and reversal&nbsp;hereby approved (including to the climbing frame, baby gate to staircase, lighting, historic staircase handrail,&nbsp;front garden, and walling including shelving) shall be completed in full, in accordance with details required by the conditions attached to this consent, within 24 months of the date of this approval.<br>REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">The following details are to be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the work:</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">a) Method statement and trial area for removal of paint to handrail to staircase.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">b) Method statement for removal of baby gate fixings to staircase and making good spindle</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">c) Method statement for installation of wattle and daub walling.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">Reason to preserve the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and materials, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent. </span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained as such thereafter.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt">Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the internal CCTV cameras are to be removed and affected fabric made good within three months of the date of this approval.</span><br></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></p>
description: Listed Building Consent (part retrospective): Internal and external alterations including staircase works, reinstating walling, installing internal climbing frame, baby gates, finger guards, shelving, fire system and external landscaping and roofing over of A/C enclosure.
